Understanding Aqualyx Fat Dissolving

Aqualyx is a revolutionary, non-surgical fat-dissolving treatment. It contains deoxycholic acid, a substance naturally produced by the human body to digest dietary fats. When injected into targeted areas of stubborn subcutaneous fat—such as a double chin, bingo wings, or love handles—Aqualyx liquefies the fat cells.

Once the fat cells are destroyed, they are naturally metabolized and excreted by the body's lymphatic system, resulting in a permanently slimmer, more contoured profile. It is a fantastic alternative to liposuction for localized fat deposits.

Key Benefits

  • Permanently destroys fat cells in the treated area.
  • Highly effective for a double chin, jowls, and body contouring.
  • Non-surgical with significantly less downtime than liposuction.
  • Improves skin tightening as the fat reduces.

Suitable Candidates

Ideal for clients who are close to their ideal body weight but have localized, stubborn fat deposits that do not respond to diet or exercise.

Who Should Avoid

  • Clients seeking a general weight-loss solution (it is for contouring, not weight loss).
  • Pregnant or breastfeeding women.
  • Those with severe kidney or liver disease.

The Treatment Journey

1. Step-by-Step Procedure

  1. Marking: The target area is carefully mapped and marked.
  2. Injection: Aqualyx (mixed with a local anesthetic) is injected using a specialized cannula technique to fan the product evenly through the fat layer.

Recovery

Significant swelling is expected and necessary (it indicates the product is working). Swelling peaks at 48 hours and can last for 1-2 weeks. Bruising is common.

Results

Results are not immediate. The body takes 4-6 weeks to clear the destroyed fat cells. Multiple sessions (2-5) may be required.

Maintenance

The destruction of fat cells is permanent, provided you maintain a stable weight.

Risks

Prolonged swelling, bruising, temporary numbness, and rare risks of uneven fat removal.

Aftercare

  • Drink plenty of water to aid the lymphatic system.
  • Wear a compression garment if advised.
  • Avoid strenuous exercise for 1 week.

FAQs

Will the fat return?

The treated fat cells are destroyed permanently. However, if you gain weight, the remaining fat cells in the area can expand.
